policy: This map records manually inspected source-to-test links. It does not upgrade feature-inventory.json statuses. Static assertions and unit tests are not Discord runtime or production verification.

test.name: market purchases serialize the player before charging and never allow a negative balance

entries.limitation: The test inspects transaction ordering and SQL guards; it does not execute a Discord market purchase.

test.name: trade offers are persistent, expiring and single-use

entries.limitation: Static source assertions cover reservation and acceptance invariants; no live player-to-player Discord trade is performed.

test.name: solo boss reward persistence is idempotent per battle session across duplicate handlers

test.name: legendary set bonus activates at two pieces and disappears when one is removed

entries.limitation: The unit test proves the shared set-bonus calculation and source wiring is present in combat handlers; it does not execute full solo, dungeon and raid encounters.

entries.limitation: The test checks lock ordering, quantity bounds and transaction structure; it does not perform a live Discord crafting action.
